remarks: BRAND NEW | CUL-DE-SAC | PIE LOT | TRIPLE GARAGE | SIDE ENTRANCE. Welcome to Southfort Meadows! This 2,318 sq ft home makes a statement the moment you walk in. The great room has an 18 ft open-to-above ceiling and a dramatic full-height feature wall with an electric fireplace. There are 9 ft ceilings and oversized 8 ft doors throughout. The extended kitchen features quartz countertops and a walk-through pantry. The main floor also has a mudroom, a powder room and a flexible bedroom/den. Upstairs, the primary suite is a true retreat. Its ensuite has a stand-alone tub, separate shower, double vanity and makeup desk, then continues into the walk-in closet and walk-through laundry, so there's no hauling baskets down the hall. Two more bedrooms and a full bath complete the upper floor. Don't miss this one! (id:67522)
